description: phx - back up what a developer machine would lose in a crash (repo inventory, local-only git work, gitignored local files, Claude Code memory, machine setup) and rebuild a new one from it.
post_install: # The registry PSModulePath was just extended; this process still has the old value.
$mods = if (Get-Command modulesdir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { modulesdir $global } else { Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $dir))) 'modules' }
notes: Import-Module PSPhoenix, then: phx init (wizard) - or phx help.
PowerShell 7.4+ only; secrets need age: scoop install age
